title: Manyhands JSON v1 path observation
description: What path observe found at a path in a context. It never holds what the file contains.

path.description: Relative to the context, with forward slashes.

exists.description: Whether a file is at the path.

observation.description: The token a write takes as its precondition: the file's, as the item reads give it, or the absent token of the context's branch and the path.
